armorite-ore.name: Armorite Ore
armorite-ore.flavor_text: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.

balm-mushroom.name: Balm Mushroom
balm-mushroom.short_desc: Sell to Hungry Maid for 25000 Pokedollars.
balm-mushroom.flavor_text: A rare mushroom that gives off a nice fragrance. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

beach-glass.name: Beach Glass
beach-glass.flavor_text: A piece of colored glass. Waves have rounded its edges. Its slightly rough to the touch.

big-mushroom.name: Big Mushroom
big-mushroom.short_desc: Fire Red and Leaf Green: Trade for prior Level-up moves. Sell for 2500 Pokedollars, or to Hungry Maid for 5000 Pokedollars.
big-mushroom.flavor_text: A very large and rare mushroom. Its popular with a certain class of collectors.

big-nugget.name: Big Nugget
big-nugget.short_desc: Sell to Ore Collector for 30000 Pokedollars.
big-nugget.flavor_text: A big nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

big-pearl.name: Big Pearl
big-pearl.short_desc: Sell for 3750 Pokedollars, or to Ore Collector for 7500 Pokedollars.
big-pearl.flavor_text: A rather large pearl that has a very nice silvery sheen. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

blue-shard.name: Blue Shard
blue-shard.short_desc: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
blue-shard.desc: No effect. In Diamond and Pearl, trade ten for a Rain Dance TM in the house midway along the southern section of Route 212. In Platinum, trade to move tutors on Route 212, in Snowpoint City, and in the Survival Area. Eight shards total are required per tutelage, but the particular combination of colors varies by move. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Chesto Berry, an Oran Berry, and a Wiki Berry with the Juggler near the Pokemon Center in Violet City. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Bluk Berry, a Cornn Berry, and a Kelpsy Berry with the Juggler near the Pal Park entrance in Fuchsia City.
blue-shard.flavor_text: A small blue shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.

bottle-cap.name: Bottle Cap
bottle-cap.short_desc: Trade to Mr. Hyper to maximize one of a Pokemons genes.
bottle-cap.desc: Trade to Mr. Hyper to set one of a Pokemons genes to 31.
bottle-cap.flavor_text: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a silver gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.

chalky-stone.name: Chalky Stone
chalky-stone.flavor_text: A small whitish stone picked up at the edge of the road.

comet-shard.name: Comet Shard
comet-shard.short_desc: Sell to Ore Collector for 60000 Pokedollars.
comet-shard.flavor_text: A shard that fell to the ground when a comet approached. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

discount-coupon.name: Discount Coupon
discount-coupon.short_desc: Can be used at a boutique for a 50% discount. Consumed once used.
discount-coupon.desc: Can be used at a boutique for a 50% discount. Consumed once used.
discount-coupon.flavor_text: This special coupon allows you to buy items at a discount when you are shopping at a boutique.

dynite-ore.name: Dynite Ore
dynite-ore.flavor_text: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector in the Crown Tundra.

galarica-cuff.name: Galarica Cuff
galarica-cuff.flavor_text: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokemon very happy.

galarica-twig.name: Galarica Twig
galarica-twig.flavor_text: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows in certain areas around the Galar region. Its a material for an accessory for a certain Pokemon.

galarica-wreath.name: Galarica Wreath
galarica-wreath.flavor_text: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokemon very happy.

gold-bottle-cap.name: Gold Bottle Cap
gold-bottle-cap.short_desc: Trade to Mr. Hyper to maximize all of a Pokemons genes.
gold-bottle-cap.desc: Trade to Mr. Hyper to set all of a Pokemons genes to 31.
gold-bottle-cap.flavor_text: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a golden gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.

gold-leaf.name: Gold Leaf
gold-leaf.flavor_text: A mysterious gold leaf. No trees with this leaf have been found yet.

green-shard.name: Green Shard
green-shard.short_desc: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
green-shard.desc: No effect. In Diamond and Pearl, trade ten for a Hail TM in the house midway along the southern section of Route 212. In Platinum, trade to move tutors on Route 212, in Snowpoint City, and in the Survival Area. Eight shards total are required per tutelage, but the particular combination of colors varies by move. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for an Aguav Berry, a Lum Berry, and a Rawst Berry with the Juggler near the Pokemon Center in Violet City. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Durin Berry, a Hondew Berry, and a Wepear Berry with the Juggler near the Pal Park entrance in Fuchsia City.
green-shard.flavor_text: A small green shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.

heart-scale.name: Heart Scale
heart-scale.short_desc: No effect. Can be traded for prior Level-up moves.
heart-scale.desc: Trade one to the Move Relearner near the shore in Pastoria City or with the Move Deleter in Blackthorn City to teach one party Pokemon a prior level-up move.
heart-scale.flavor_text: A pretty, heart-shaped scale that is extremely rare. Some people are happy to receive one.

leaf-letter--eevee.name: Leaf Letter
leaf-letter--eevee.flavor_text: A letter written on a leaf. Something is written using Eevees footprints.

leaf-letter--pikachu.name: Leaf Letter
leaf-letter--pikachu.flavor_text: A letter written on a leaf. Something is written using Pikachus footprints.

lone-earring.name: Lone Earring
lone-earring.flavor_text: A single earring that somebody dropped.

marble.name: Marble
marble.flavor_text: A round glass marble. You can see colored glass inside the transparent marble.

nugget.name: Nugget
nugget.desc: A nugget of pure gold that can be sold for a high price.
nugget.flavor_text: A nugget of the purest gold that gives off a lustrous gleam in direct light. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.short_desc: Sell for 700 Pokedollars, or to Ore Collector for 1400 Pokedollars.
pearl.flavor_text: A rather small pearl that has a very nice silvery sheen to it. It can be sold at a low price to shops.

pearl-string.name: Pearl String
pearl-string.short_desc: Sell to Ore Collector for 25000 Pokedollars.
pearl-string.flavor_text: Very large pearls that sparkle in a pretty silver color. They can be sold at a high price to shops.

polished-mud-ball.name: Polished Mud Ball
polished-mud-ball.flavor_text: A ball made of mud. It had been polished for such a long time that the surface is very shiny.

pretty-wing.name: Pretty Feather
pretty-wing.flavor_text: Though this feather is beautiful, its just a regular feather and has no effect.

rare-bone.name: Rare Bone
rare-bone.short_desc: Sell for 5000 Pokedollars, or to Bone Man for 10000 Pokedollars.
rare-bone.flavor_text: A rare bone that is extremely valuable for the study of Pokemon archeology. It can be sold for a high price to shops.

red-shard.name: Red Shard
red-shard.short_desc: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
red-shard.desc: No effect. In Diamond and Pearl, trade ten for a Sunny Day TM in the house midway along the southern section of Route 212. In Platinum, trade to move tutors on Route 212, in Snowpoint City, and in the Survival Area. Eight shards total are required per tutelage, but the particular combination of colors varies by move. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Cheri Berry, a Leppa Berry, and a Pecha Berry with the Juggler near the Pokemon Center in Violet City. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Persim Berry, a Pomeg Berry, and a Razz Berry with the Juggler near the Pal Park entrance in Fuchsia City.
red-shard.flavor_text: A small red shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.

relic-band.name: Relic Band
relic-band.short_desc: Sell to Villa Owner for 100000 Pokedollars.
relic-band.flavor_text: A heavy bracelet made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-copper.name: Relic Copper
relic-copper.short_desc: Sell to Villa Owner for 1000 Pokedollars.
relic-copper.flavor_text: A copper coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-crown.name: Relic Crown
relic-crown.short_desc: Sell to Villa Owner for 300000 Pokedollars.
relic-crown.flavor_text: A heavy crown made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-gold.name: Relic Gold
relic-gold.flavor_text: A gold coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-silver.name: Relic Silver
relic-silver.flavor_text: A silver coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-statue.name: Relic Statue
relic-statue.flavor_text: A stone figurine made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-vase.name: Relic Vase
relic-vase.flavor_text: A fragile vase made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

shoal-salt.name: Shoal Salt
shoal-salt.short_desc: No effect. Gen III: Trade four and four Shoal Shells for a Shell Bell.
shoal-salt.flavor_text: Salt that you found inside Shoal Cave.

shoal-shell.name: Shoal Shell
shoal-shell.short_desc: No effect. Gen III: Trade four and four Shoal Salts for a Shell Bell.
shoal-shell.flavor_text: A seashell that you found inside Shoal Cave.

silver-leaf.name: Silver Leaf
silver-leaf.flavor_text: A mysterious silver leaf. No trees with this leaf have been found yet.

small-bouquet.name: Small Bouquet
small-bouquet.flavor_text: A small bouquet that was made with heart and soul for a single Trainer.

star-piece.name: Star Piece
star-piece.short_desc: Platinum: Trade for one of each color Shard. Black and White: Trade for PP Up. Sell for 4900 Pokedollars, or to Ore Collector for 9800 Pokedollars.
star-piece.flavor_text: A small shard of a beautiful gem that gives off a distinctly red sparkle. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

stardust.name: Stardust
stardust.desc: Lovely red sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold for money.
stardust.flavor_text: Lovely red sand that flows between the fingers with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a low price to shops.

strange-souvenir.name: Strange Souvenir
strange-souvenir.flavor_text: An ornament depicting a mysterious Pokemon that has been venerated as a guardian deity for an extremely long time in the Alola region.

stretchy-spring.name: Stretchy Spring
stretchy-spring.flavor_text: A thin small spring. Its totally stretched out, and what its used for is unknown.

tiny-mushroom.name: Tiny Mushroom
tiny-mushroom.short_desc: Fire Red and Leaf Green: Trade two for prior Level-up moves. Sell for 250 Pokedollars, or to Hungry Maid for 500 Pokedollars.
tiny-mushroom.flavor_text: A very small and rare mushroom. Its popular with a certain class of collectors.

tropical-shell.name: Tropical Shell
tropical-shell.flavor_text: A beautiful white shell that may have drifted from a sea in a warm region.

wishing-piece.name: Wishing Piece
wishing-piece.flavor_text: Throw one into a Pokemon Den to attract a wild Dynamax Pokemon.

yellow-shard.name: Yellow Shard
yellow-shard.short_desc: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
yellow-shard.desc: No effect. In Diamond and Pearl, trade ten for a Sandstorm TM in the house midway along the southern section of Route 212. In Platinum, trade to move tutors on Route 212, in Snowpoint City, and in the Survival Area. Eight shards total are required per tutelage, but the particular combination of colors varies by move. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for an Aspear Berry, a Iapapa Berry, and a Sitrus Berry with the Juggler near the Pokemon Center in Violet City. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Grepa Berry, a Nomel Berry, and a Pinap Berry with the Juggler near the Pal Park entrance in Fuchsia City.
yellow-shard.flavor_text: A small yellow shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.
